# LTspice 24.0.12 semiconductor diode witnesses

Numeric resolved model/instance inputs in `*-cases.tsv` are ordered to match the corresponding exported measurements. DC data is terminal current in A, AC data real and imaginary admittance at 1 kHz. Intrinsic and clipping sweeps were measured in LTspice using ideal voltage excitation and individual current probes. The hot clipping case's first sample is the separately measured intrinsic I(D10) at .op zero bias: the sweep's first-point inspection reported zero voltage-source current despite nonzero diode current. All subsequent samples use the voltage-source probe. No fitted reference samples are generated by the Rust implementation.
